purpose: Machine-readable registry of XAI's product surfaces, modules, and desktop-plugin sub-modules, plus the routing signals and boundary rules used to classify a new feature into exactly one module. Consumed by the xai-module-classify skill and mirrored into the dev-dashboard. This is the data form of docs/MODULE_BOUNDARIES.md + docs/PRODUCT_MODULE_MAP.md.

hard_rules: physical host implementation is not product ownership: Tauri/native-window commands live in the host process (apps/desktop/src-tauri), but desktop multi-window/overlay/widget runtime is a plugin product concern; Mac shell/native chrome work is app
Web-already-covered full modules are not re-built as web-form inside plugins; App reuses business-logic packages via the D3 gate
plugin entities default syncScope=device-local and NEVER enter the remote outbox; only explicit account-sync entities sync (ADR-0013 D4)
Web pet/widgets/grid (in-page DOM) are NOT the same as desktop pet/widgets/grid (native overlay) — same name, zero code sharing
web->app only via the D3 gate (xai-web-to-desktop-sync); never merge web directly into dev
future iPhone/iPad/Apple Watch/Android/browser-extension surfaces are planning-only future_surfaces; never classify them as active module targets without operator confirmation

frozen_lines.plugin: P2 packages (clipboard/widgets/pet/meditation) PAUSED until G1 SHIPPED — brief/impact-note only, no source landing. Plugin platform-runtime / G1 native-foundation anchor (multi-window engine, grid persistence, window-command) is the ACTIVE gate (P1 App-lane execution, plugin-platform product), NOT frozen.
frozen_lines.sync: P2 PAUSED until G1 SHIPPED — receipt only
frozen_lines.admin: OPERATOR-ACTIVATED 2026-06-05 — roadmap-gated; only `codex/admin/<feature>` via `docs/workflow/roadmap/xai-admin-dashboard-system-integration.md`, first slice `xai-admin-dashboard-shell`; no production admin writes before RBAC/audit/secret/deploy gates

modules.name: Mac 桌面壳 App（Web 容器）
signals: host command implementation for shell/platform integration
modules.identity: thin native shell hosting the Web SPA; product identity is 'Web container', NOT a desktop organizer
modules.form: thin native shell hosting the Web SPA (Web container)
not_owns: 桌面挂件/便签/悬浮面板
桌面整理/Smart Container — 这些归桌面插件产品(plugin)
modules.physical_vs_product: 原生窗口/文件/剪贴板的 Tauri 命令物理上实现在 host (apps/desktop/src-tauri, 只有 host 能调 Tauri), 但多窗口/overlay 运行时的产品归属是桌面插件平台(plugin.platform_runtime), 不是 Mac 壳的身份。壳只是把 Web 装进原生窗 + 原生便利能力。

modules.name: 桌面整理插件 / Widget
signals: 桌面整理/Smart Container/Grid 容器
快速入口/快速操作小窗
浮动小组件/便签/进度条/桌宠/剪贴板
modules.form: lightweight overlay/grid window on the App plugin platform
modules.data: device-local by default (never syncs unless explicitly account-sync)
modules.platform_runtime: the multi-window/overlay engine (native sub-windows, click-through, Spaces, grid persistence, Plugin Host/SDK) is a PLUGIN-product concern; its code physically lives in the Tauri host (apps/desktop/src-tauri, app-lane execution) but its product attribution is plugin, NOT the Mac shell's identity

sub_modules.decision: ADR-0015 web-side Accepted: delivered/graduated flagship (Stable/shipped), NOT in the P2-paused freeze; dev ADR-0011 P3 reconcile pending operator
ADR-0015 Accepted: independent package plugin-pet (not a widgets sub-module)

sub_modules.note: NO package on disk yet; Web form shipped as xai-web-meditation

modules.name: 账号云同步层
modules.rule: only account-sync entities sync; device-local never does (ADR-0013 D4)

future_surfaces.rule: NOT current modules; NEVER an active classification target. The classifier must not route work here without an operator-confirmed unfreeze that promotes a surface into MODULE_BOUNDARIES.md as a current module. These are 'surfaces of the one product', planned by role, reusing the shared core (data model + account + sync + portable UI).

classification_flow.ask: 命中哪个模块的任务归属信号?
浏览器能否实现且是完整功能页面?
是 Mac 壳/Web 容器/native chrome,还是桌面插件平台运行时/轻量挂件?
classification_flow.note: Tauri 命令物理位置不决定产品归属;按产品意图分类

classification_flow.yes: entities.ts 标 account-sync -> sync 线 (D4)

classification_flow.ask: 改动源自 Web 要流向 App?
classification_flow.yes: 走 D3 闸门 (W0-W4) via xai-web-to-desktop-sync

classification_flow.ask: 是否是 iPhone/iPad/Apple Watch/Android/browser-extension 等未来面?
classification_flow.yes: future_surfaces planning-only; no active module branch unless operator promotes it into MODULE_BOUNDARIES.md

drift_checks.rule: every module.surface / sub_module.package path that is a packages/* dir MUST exist on disk; flag Planned-no-package rows (e.g. plugin-meditation, plugin-settings) so docs don't read as if the package exists
every plugin entity MUST declare syncScope in packages/core-data/src/entities.ts; device-local entities must be excluded from the outbox (delegate proof to xai-account-sync-scope-check)
a feature named pet/widgets/grid/dashboard MUST be tagged web-DOM vs desktop-native; they are different modules despite the shared word

no source may land on frozen plugin packages (clipboard/widgets/pet/meditation), sync (PAUSED), or site (PROPOSED) without an operator-confirmed unfreeze; admin is operator-activated but roadmap-gated, so source may land only through the admin roadmap gates and must not skip shell/RBAC/audit/secret/deploy prerequisites; plugin platform-runtime / G1 native-foundation anchor is the ACTIVE gate and is not frozen
if a feature matches no module signal or matches 2+ with equal weight, escalate to operator instead of guessing

HR1: a plugin package must NOT implement a native window/file/clipboard Tauri command (window.rs-style) — it may only consume them; flag any such implementation under packages/plugin-*/src as an App-lane responsibility
flag docs/rules that present the Mac shell as the desktop organizer/overlay product, or classify plugin platform runtime as App product ownership only because code lives in apps/desktop/src-tauri
flag iPhone/iPad/Apple Watch/Android/browser-extension work presented as active feature-build/module work instead of planning-only future_surfaces without operator confirmation

HR2: a plugin must NOT re-build the web-form of a Web-covered module (tasks/board/calendar/pomodoro/habits/statistics/...); it should share the business-logic package (plugin-productivity/project/labels). Flag duplicate full-module rebuilds
HR5: a Web change must reach the App/dev line only via the D3 gate (xai-web-to-desktop-sync) with a parity receipt; flag web->dev merges or App-affecting Web changes with no D3 classification

consumers.skill: xai-module-classify (classify a new feature + scan for drift)
consumers.audit_skill: xai-consistency-audit (periodic boundary + feature + registration audit; consumes these drift_checks + consistency-checks.json)
consumers.dashboard: docs/prototypes/dev-dashboard/index.html (产品结构图 / module map panel)
